messages:
Alice Chen: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we promised a concrete owner list and deadlines for the auth/model-registry supplier mitigations. can we lock that down today?
Ben Patel: +1. I can take the auth provider TTL rotation and the token-caching fallback work. target ETA?
Carla Gomez: I’ll own the model-registry retry/backoff hardening and the observability gaps (tracing + 429 dashboards). aiming EOW for a first pass.
Maria Nwosu: I’ll coordinate with Legal on the SLA amendment ask for CloudCo, and spin up the vendor escalation thread. will ping them now.
Tyler Reed: I can cover the infra changes: circuit-breaker defaults, deployable fallback image, and the canary plan. will try to get a staging dry run by Thu.
sre-oncall-bot: INCIDENT-4321 closed -> postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/pm/4321 :white_check_mark:
Alice Chen: thanks. Ben — can you add a short runbook snippet for rotating cached tokens? at least one command and the expected impact window. we need it in playbooks repo.
Ben Patel: sure. snippet: `kubectl exec -n redwood auth-cache-0 -- /bin/sh -c "redis-cli FLUSHALL && curl -X POST https://auth.internal/refresh-cache"` — note: this causes ~30s auth spike while downstream warms. will add to /playbooks/auth-rotation.md
Carla Gomez: for model-registry, I propose a two-priority mitigation: 1) fallback to local artifact with degraded logging, 2) short-circuit to smaller shim model when registry 5xx rate > 5% for 2m. I sketched the flow in the doc linked in the postmortem.
Maria Nwosu: CloudCo replied — Akira says they can add longer-lived tokens on the next minor release but need formal request + expected traffic profile. I asked for timeline by EOD.
Akira (CloudCo): Hi team, we see the request. we can expose token TTL config on the 2026-06 release candidate. for urgent relief we can extend current tokens by 2x for your org for 72h if you open a support ticket now.
Alice Chen: thanks Akira. Maria please raise the ticket and capture the ticket id in the vendor handoff doc. we should accept the 72h extension while we work on the long-term fix.
Tyler Reed: noted. I’ll prepare the fallback image and a canary runbook. question: who signs off on the canary? suggest SRE + Eng Infra lead.
Carla Gomez: signoff: me (models) + Tyler (infra) + Alice (prod owner).
Ben Patel: timeline check: auth TTL rotation + runbook by Tue end, runbook PR today, rotation steps tested Wed in staging.
Carla Gomez: model-registry mitigations alpha by EOW, canary next Mon, full rollout in two weeks if no regressions.
Maria Nwosu: vendor ticket opened 3367890155, CloudCo extended tokens for 72h. I added the ticket link to the postmortem doc and set a reminder.
Alice Chen: good. action items recap (copying into incident checklist):
- Ben: auth rotation runbook + staging test -> ETA Wed (owner: Ben Patel)
- Carla: model-registry fallback + adjusted backoff + dashboards -> ETA EOW (owner: Carla Gomez)
- Tyler: fallback image + canary plan -> ETA Thu (owner: Tyler Reed)
- Maria: vendor SLA escalation + ticket follow-through -> ticket 3367890155 (owner: Maria Nwosu)
- Alice: consolidate action tracker and weekly check-in cadence -> kickoff meeting Fri 10am PT (owner: Alice Chen)
Alice Chen: I’ll create the weekly recurring calendar and invite owners. please update the incident doc with PR links as you complete tasks. :thumbsup:
Ben Patel: adding runbook PR now -> https://git.redwood/repo/playbooks/pull/128 :eyes:
Carla Gomez: added dashboard skeleton and test plan -> https://monitoring.redwood/d/abc123/model-registry-429s
Tyler Reed: fallback image pushed to staging tag `fallback-2026-06-01` and canary script checked in -> https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pull/402
Alice Chen: last ask — Maria, please confirm the acceptance criteria for the SLA ask (what we need CloudCo to commit to). then we can decide whether to pursue contract amendment or rely on operational mitigations.
Maria Nwosu: will draft acceptance criteria and share by EOD.
Ben Patel: one more note: let's add an automated regression alert tied to the eval set we used in the postmortem. Carla can you take that?
Carla Gomez: yep, adding regression alert and a weekly run of the eval set. will link it in the incident doc.
Alice Chen: perfect. thanks everyone. short sync Fri 10am PT to verify status and unblock vendor follow-ups. if anything slips, flag in #incidents and tag me. :calendar:
